description: This file defines the Supabase integration class for logging events and responses related to a language model system within the Litellm project. It manages connection setup, event logging methods, and exception handling.

classes.name: Supabase
classes.description: A class encapsulating the logic to interact with the Supabase service for logging request and response events related to language model interactions.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the Supabase client with URL and key from environment variables, installing the 'supabase' package if necessary.

methods.name: input_log_event( self, model, messages, end_user, litellm_call_id, print_verbose )
methods.description: Logs the initial input event details to the Supabase table, including model, messages, and user info.

methods.name: log_event( self, model, messages, end_user, response_obj, start_time, end_time, litellm_call_id, print_verbose, )
methods.description: Logs the response or error details after processing, including timing, cost, and model response/error contents.
